tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bi rū pa'i man ngag gong ma'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi las rim grub chen bi rū pa'i man ngag tu grags pa 'di la don brgyad de/ slob ma yongs bzung bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ /sa chog sta gon gnas pa rnam bzhi dang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri zhing rgyan dgram sgrub mchod dang*/ /dbang gi cho ga mjug gi bya ba'o/ /de las dang po slob ma yongs bzung dang*/ gnyis pa bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ slob dpon rtse mo'i dbang chu chen mor blta bar bya la/ gsum pa sa chog la rgyas pa ni bzang po yongs bzung dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba las 'byung ba dang*/ 'bring po ni dbang chu chen mo'i dngos bstan la phyis kyi bsre bslad med pa'i lugs su sbyar zhing*/ bsdus pa ni 'di tsam gyis kyang 'grub ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngon 'gro gtor ma'i rim pa dang*/ sa lha sta gon gyi cho ga'i spyi dang khyad par gyi sa bslangs/ a mṛ ta bzla shing*/ sa gzhi ba byung gis byugs/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ yung chu dang thal bas sbyang*/ sa gzhi der skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par byas la/ mthar mchod bstod bya/ oṃ badz+ra u dhiṣ+ṭha zhes nam mkhar bteg / rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ hūṃ zhes snyems pa dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi bcags/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma nas/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa 'i sngags kyi bar thun mong gi srung 'khor bzhin bya'o/ /bzhi pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ sta gon gyi dang por bya ba dang*/ sta gon dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ mahā bhu ta sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ in+d+ra dza ma zhes sogs lan gsum gyis phul/

puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod lnga dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya'o/ / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na zhes pa tsam mam/ dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na bsrung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang stongs grogs mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /a mṛ ta bzla/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khaṃ bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta bab bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur/

oṃ ni ri te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ ni wi te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai bai te/ shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ni ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta na da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya/ san to ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ las kyi slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes sam/ rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa gsang sngags 'chang ba 'di/ zhes bya ba dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin ni zab mo la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ / zhes dang*/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*/ /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsags bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ / ces brjod/ tshogs pas/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ / bla mas kyang*/ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab du gsol/ zhes 'bul/ de nas bla mas/ thugs dam zab mo'i rim pa la 'jug par zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas/

skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa bya ba'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms la bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin rlabs stsal te/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad zhes pa nas/ slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis par gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ gnyis pa la bzhi las dang po sa lha sta gon ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes sogs kyis skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ la sogs pas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya'o/ / slar yang snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rig lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chus lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ pri thi bī de wī zhes so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i ni ri te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ sogs nas/ shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi bī de wī a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/

/kyai rdo rje khros mchod pa'i/ /lha ma khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /shākya sed+ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ / lan gsum/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzheng par 'tshal na/ sa phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo/ / rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khaur gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig / ces gnang ba byin par mos/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi badz+ra muḥsa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim/ gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ mdun bskyed mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma nas/ gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nas/ rtsibs bcu pa bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa nas/ dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ hūṃ shrī he badz+ra ya na maḥ dbus su bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ naṃ badz+ra nai rāt+ma na maḥ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon po nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gaṃ gau rī na maḥ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ tsaṃ tsau rī na maḥ lhor tsau rī sogs/ baṃ bai ta lī na maḥ nub tu bai ta lī sogs/ ghaṃ ghasma rī na maḥ byang du ghasma rī

sogs/ paṃ puk+ka sī na maḥ byang shar du puk+ka sī sogs/ shri shā wa rī na maḥ shar lhor shā wa rī sogs/ laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sogs/ ḍaṃ ḍom+bhi nī na maḥ nub byang du g.yung mo sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas stim/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ / nas/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum dang gau rī nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhes pa nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ni ri te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar brjod/ de nas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ni ri te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di/ /ni we te/ lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di/ /sarba saṃ sho dha ni/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho khaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/

me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas dbul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas= /oṃ bha ga wān sngon du 'gro ba'i badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*/ / gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gi= /bzhes nas= /dhu pe pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnams sel 'di/ / bdag gi= /bzhes nas= /dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi= /bzhes nas= /gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas gshos 'di dgabadag gis= /bzhes nas= /nai wi te pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ dri med= /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bcom ldan= /bzhes nas= /badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ghan+ṭe ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bha ga wān nas/ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyogs ba~Xcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i= rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i= grub chen nag po pa'i= grub thob ḍa ma ru pa'i= slob dpon a wa dhu tī pa'i= paṇa chen ga ya dha ra'i= 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi=

se ston kun rig gi= zhang ston chos 'bar gyi= bla ma sa skya chen po'i= slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo'i= rje btsun grags pa rgyal rgyal mtshan gyi= chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i= 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i= zhang dkon mchog dpal gyi= na za brag phug pa'i= bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi= sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi= theg chen kun dga' bkra shis kyi= rig 'dzin gzhon nu blo gros kyi= paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan gyi= rin po che gzhon nu chos grub kyi= rje kun dga' grol mchog gi= rje rdo ring dbon gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'am/ yang na/ brag phug pa'i rjes la/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ bud+dha shri ri ba/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ man sngar bzhin/ yang na/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog / man sngar bzhin/ yang na theg chen gyi rjes la/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po'i= rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi= rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal gyi= thugs sras shākya kun dga'i= slob dpon ye shes dbang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de wa pi tsu

sogs/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badz+ra sogs/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nas/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de nas/ ye shes kyi mgon po mahā ka la lcam dral gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyi bzhes pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi zhal du= gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tsha n+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' pau dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du= zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjod byed*/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma grub pa rnams kyi zhal du= bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag/yul bdag /grong bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du= 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūṃ/

zhes rang gis kyang myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs dang*/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ / bdag med mas ni mgul la 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i steng na nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /gnag pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ / mi dang sha rā bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brgyad dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yis bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor mtshan/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ / dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar/ kha dog gnag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tsaṃ las skyes pa'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sprul dang thod pas brel/

/drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan cing paṃ las byung*/ /g.yon pa dgra sta seṅge g.yas/ / dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puk+ka sī sngo la/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung*/ /me ru gnod sbyin steng du mnan/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa yis/ /dge slong 'jin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por tsaṃ las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong gshol 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍaṃ las 'khrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thags bzang rigs steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ / dngos po kun kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na bzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyi nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid las 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /zhi ba'i bde stsol rig mar bsdud byed pa'i/ /shes rab chags pas bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyi/ /gnas su zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gi bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /hūṃ/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri bar bdag 'tshal lo/

/de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba dang*/ /gangs su rdo rje'i spyan snga rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /'gro ba dag phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung ste/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar 'byon par mdzad pa'i rigs/ / lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi 'gul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ nas/ thags bzang rigs dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo nas/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te/ nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa thig le cha dgur gyur/

de rnams gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ hūṃ rnams su gyur/ de rnams lha mo brgyad bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa dgur gyur pa/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ zhes sogs kyi lha mo brgyad gsal gdab/ las thams cad kyi bum par khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī sogs dgug gzhug dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs pa rnams gzhan 'dra ba la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ bha ga wān/ zhes sogs re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ hūṃ aṃ gaṃ sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi mthar/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ / sogs kyis bstod la/ bdag gis zhal nas sngags kyi 'od zer dmar po byung ste gzung thag la brten te song lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud skul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang*/ 'khor gyi sngags thung rnams dang/ las bum la 'khyil pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla/ slar gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nas/ bzod par gsol gyi bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de nas gtor ma rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa nas/ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūṃ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi char pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje nas/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi char pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje nas/ thugs kar hūṃ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de nas dgug gzhug /dbang lha spyan drangs te mchod cing gsol ba btab pa dang dbang bskur ba rnams sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog ltar byed pa las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa zhes pa nas 'phrin bcol ba'i bar yang mngon rtogs kyi gtor chog ltar ro/ / rjes chog ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ re re'i mgor/ oṃ bha ga wān/ sogs sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pa dang*/ hūṃ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i zhal du mchod ba dam pa 'bul lo/ /dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs bya la/ 'og tu yang phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams bya zhes 'byung ba rnams 'di bzhin du shes par bya'o/

/de nas he+u ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra u dhiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ slar yang phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la zhes sogs nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ sku gzugs kyi rten med na de mi dgos/ de nas rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs gsal btab mchod pa dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ / de nas bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ skabs 'di'am rjes chog gi sngon la'ang rung ste/ de la don bcu bzhi las/ dang po lus kyi bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams khrus legs par byas te/ snyim par me tog dang bcas pas gral la rim pa bzhin du 'khod/ gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po skyed pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/

/blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ / 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ / ces so/ / gsum pa nang dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa las/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod khrag /mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa'i rnam par gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs thugs kar 'od du zhu/ rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ slob ma rnams la thim/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas phyir spros te stan la 'khod/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing thal mo sbyar te/

bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / zhes rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ lnga pa gsang sngags la spro ba skyed pa ni/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun kyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen te/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seṅge skyob pa yi/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang des bcom ste/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces so/ / drug pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni skyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ ces lan gsum rjes bzlos byed/ bdun pa srung ba bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyi rtsa sngags lan gsum bzlas la/ slob ma'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ thig le byas pas/ spyi bor oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥdang pad ma las gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar hūṃ dang rdo rje las thugs rdo rje bsam mo/ /de nas yang mas nas yar reg cing*/ hūṃ āḥ.oṃ/ de bzhin du yang yas nas mar reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas gnas gsum du thim pas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsam mo/ / brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i sngags dang bcas pas/ spyi bor me tog /mdun du spos/ mig sngar mar me/ snying gar byug pa/ zhal du zhal zas rnams sbyin no/ / dgu pa so shing dor ba ni/ oṃ dzi hwa badz+ra saṃ brta ni swāhā/ zhes so shing sbyin la/ 'di ni rin po che gser ram dngul las byas par mos shing*/ de'i rtse mo nas 'cha' bas/ sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin/ sdig sgrib thams cad phyir phyung bar bsgoms la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor cig ces brjod do/ / oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ de la slob dpon gyis dngos grub lung bstan to// bcu pa srung skud gdags pa ni/ skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa/ gsum sgril du byas pa de la/ hūṃ bzlas shing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas la/ mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i skud par bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyi sta gon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi skud pa bkug ste/ gnyis su med par stim la/ rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas shing skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcings la/ de la lag pa gnyis 'jus te/

oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ cit+taṃ shrī yeḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca badz+ra bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ / bcu gcig pa khyor chu blud pa ni/ dri zhim po'i chu la rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ hri bi shud+dha sarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ niṣ+tsa a s+ya bi shud+dhe ya sarba bi ka lpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes g.yas pa'i khyor mor chu lan gsum blugs la 'thung du gzhug go / bcu gnyis pa ku sha sbyin pa ni/ dhiḥ bzlas pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas su sbyin/ hā bzlas pa'i ku sha che ba stan du sbyin no/ / bcu gsum pa zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba skyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig/ 'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ / dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ / bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par/

/de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchod 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na/ /rang byung bskal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes brjod do/ / don bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ khyed rnams sngar byin pa'i ku sha sngas dang stan gyis la/ seṅge'i nyal stabs zhes bya ba gzhogs g.yas pa phob la nyol zhig /sang nub dkyil 'khor chen po ji lta bu mthong snyam du yid la gyis la/ gzhan 'dod chags la sogs pa'i sems ma skyed cig /rmi lam ci mthong ba yang nga la smraus shig / ces bsgos so la btang ngo*/ / lnga pa dkyil 'khor 'dri zhing rgyan dgram pa la/ thog mar thig tshon byin rlabs ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gdan gting ba la snod so sor/ dbus su rdul tshon sngon po la hūṃ/ shar du dkar po la bh+ruṃ/ lhor ser po la aṃ/ nub tu dmar po la dz+riṃ/ byang du ljang khu la khaṃ rnams slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses bris/ rang rang gi sa bon dang mthun pa'i tshon skud chun po so sor bzhag /de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ gtor ma dang bcas pa/ thig tshon rnams oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma lnga'i steng du/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ shar du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang = yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo=

lhor aṃ las rin po che ser po aṃ= rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che= yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo= nub tu dz+riṃlas pad+ma dmar po dz+riṃ= 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma= yum gos dkar mo dmar mo= byang du khaṃ las ral gri ljang khu khaṃ= don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu g.yas ral gri= yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu= thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rang 'dra'i rigs kyis bdag pos dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ dang*/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke / ghan+dhe/ nai wi ti/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gis mchod/ nang mchod gtor zhing*/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pa'i bar gyis bstod/ gtor ma bsangs spyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes brjod rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phyogs la/ ngag tu/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ rigs lnga so so zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas dam tshig gi thig tshon la thim

par bsam la/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshon mnye zhing*/ yig 'bru rnams sub/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra tsit+t+ra sa ma ye ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ de nas thig skud kyi sne mo las kyi rdo rje la gtod cing*/ ye shes kyi srad bur bsam/ ngag tu dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ oṃ phan tshun rjes su 'gro ba ste/ /chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'gro/ /chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang*/ /kun tu 'gro bas chos kun brjod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing slob mas thig skud so sor sgrim/ yang slob dpon gyis/ brjod skabs slob mas thig skud rnams phyogs gcig tu sgrim/ de nas slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yas pas dri bzang byug /thig skud rdo rje la dkri zhing 'theb srin g.yon pas bdud rtsir gtor/ a mṛ ta brjod pas srung ngo*/ /de nas slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas pas/ rang nyid kyi kyai rdo rje dang*/ slob ma gau rīr gyur ces brjod/ slob dpon gyi dril bu dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyi phyag g.yon lte ba'i thad du bzung*/ slob dpon gyis mtheb srin g.yas pas thig skud steng nas bcus te 'og tu thig lan gsum btab pas/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags pas/ khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgra yi bskul ma 'debs/ / zhes dang*/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyis/ /dus yid de phyir 'dir byon cig / ces brjod/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i lus phab ste/ sa la yang dang po lan gsum gdab/ de bzhin du tshangs thig gnyis dang*/ zur thig gnyis la'ang shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon nub la slob ma shar/ /slob dpon lho la slob ma byang*/ /slob dpon sngon 'gro tshangs thig gdab/ /slob dpon me mtshams slob ma ni/ / dbang ldan gnas pa'i shar logs dang*/ /slob mas slob dpon la bskor te/ /bden bral gnas su gnas byas nas/

/slob dpon gyis kyang slob ma la/ /bskor nas rlung du byon pa yi/ /nub kyi logs thig gdab par mdzod/ /slob dpon rlung nyid du bzhugs nas/ /slob ma dbang ldan phyin pa yis/ /byang gi logs thig gdab pa yin/ /slob dpon bskor te me mtshams dang*/ /slob mas bskor te bden bral du/ /gnas pa'i lho yi logs thig gdab/ /rdo rje slob dpon de nyid du/ / bzhugs shing las kyi rdo rje ni/ /rlung gi phyogs su song ba yis/ /zur thig dang po gdab byas la/ / slob dpon bden bral dbang ldan du/ /slob ma gnas pas dkyil 'khor gyi/ /zur thig gnyis pa'ang btab par bya/ /g.yas bskor slob dpon dbang ldan dang*/ /slob ma me mtshams mi 'gro ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rlung mtshams nas thig sna bsdud par bya'o/ /slob dpon rang nyid kyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor zlog cing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod/ sems kyis ye shes kyi thig rnams nam mkhar btegs te/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs gar thim par bsam/ de nas dbus su phyin te zhal shar la phyogs pas/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ g.yon sngon 'gro'i bca' bzhi dang*/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur dku bsten no/ / rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rje me 'bar bar bsam la/ shar sgo nas rim pa bzhin g.yas skor gyis nub sgo'i bar dang*/ yang nub sgo nas rim pa bzhin g.yon bskor gyis shar sgo'i bar du blta zhing sgo'i phyogs re re la yang*/ hiḥhiḥ zhes brjod/ de nas dri bzang gi chus sgo'i rtsa thig rnams phyi zhing*/

ngag tu/ thar pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis dbang ldan nas g.yas skor gyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis cha chen gcig gi bar du nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag po ljang khu dmar po ser po dkar po rnams bri zhing*/ ngag tu/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni dgrol bar byed/ /kyai rdo rje rgyal chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor mnyam po bri bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ phyi nang gis mchod bstod pas bstod/ ting phor la sogs pas bcad steng du rdo rje bzhag / rak+ṣa 'i sngags kyis bsrungs/ phur khung 'geng ba ni/ rim pas ljang khu dmar po dkar po ser po sngon pos dgang zhing*/ snying po brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi bri bar bya ste/ mtshan ma bri ba'i tshe rang rang gis sngags dang rtsig pa 'dri dus su rtsa sngags brjod/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa sbrel ba'i tshe rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bris tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa rdo rje dang bcas pa la lag pas bzung*/ g.yon dril bu sil/ mchod g.yog pas las bum bzung zhing*/ slob dpon gyis sngon la spos sna dang bcas pas/ ngag tu yig brgya brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya/ de'i ring la sgrub grogs pa rnams kyis rol chen byed/ de nas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa gtso bo la sogs pa'i lha so so'i mdun phyogs su bzung zhing*/ gtso bo la snying po dang gzhan rnams la rang rang gi sngags lan gsum gsum brjod pa'i mthar/

bdag dang sems can thams cad la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod cing*/ bum pa lha la 'bul ba'i stangs ka tsam byas nas rang gi mgor bor bzhag / de nas rdul tshon lhag ma rnams sngar ltar phyi nang gi mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod la/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya phyir bkrol bas/ ye shes pa sta gon gyi thugs ka dang*/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ / drug pa dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung*/ bdag bskyed rdzogs kyi bar lha sta gon bzhin las nyer bsdu'i skabs 'od gsal du zhugs/ slar yang bdag nyid kyai rdo rje gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ ces brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /de nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ zhes sogs thun mong ba'i bsrung 'khor bskyed pa dang*/ thags bzang ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan zhes pa'i bar gzhal yas khang gdan bcas sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas la/ de nas/ bdag gis sgom pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang mdun bskyed kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis sgom pa'i dur 'khrod brgyad dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis sgom pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin/ yum gyi pad+mar babs pas thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru pa gsum

nas/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nas/ gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar brjod do/ / cha gcig cha dgur gyur pa gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi thig le bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar dang*/ shar gyi thig le gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug sogs dang*/ lho'i thig le tsau rī= nub kyi thig le bai ta lī= byang gi thig le ghasma rī= byang shar gyi thig le puk+ka sī= shar lho'i thig le shā bā rī= lho nub kyi thig le gdol pa mo= nub byang gi thig le g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs zhes sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal btab/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje sku mdog zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mkha' nang gi gau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar gyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni tshangs pa'i gdan la/ gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi tsau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ dbang po'i gdan la tsau rī dmar mo/ zhes sogs zhal phyag kun la gsal btab/ mkha' nang gi bai ta lī dpag tu med pa spros/

sems can thams cad kyi 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni nye dbang gi gdan la bai ta lī ser mo sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi ghasma ri dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ drag po'i gdan la ghasma rī ljang gu sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi puk+ka sī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang shar gyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni gshin rje'i gdan la puk+ka sī sngon mo zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi shā wa rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar lho'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ nor bdag gi gdan la/ shā wa rī dkar mo zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi gdol pa mo dpag tu med spros/ sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho nub kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ srin po'i gdan la gdol pa mo sngon mo zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi g.yung mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub byang gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ thags bzang ris kyi gdan la g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma sbyangs/ dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la bkod/ tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang la thim/ mkha' nang gi dur khrod brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lus dang rnam shes tshogs brgyad sbyangs/

'khor 'das ro mnyam gyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus dur khrod brgyad la thim/ mkha' nang gi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs dang log 'dren mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ dngos gzhi dang po'i tshe lag pas rdo rje gsor zhing ngag tu aṣ+ta bzla sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ bha ga wan/ zhes sogs lan gcig oṃ ni ri zhes sogs chu bzhi phul/ oṃ bha ga wan sogs/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bya/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros nas ye shes dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams lta sta gon bzhin bya/ de nas hūṃ shrī he badz+ra oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka = sogs yig brgya ci rigs bzla/ de bzhin du/ naṃ nai rāt+ma oṃ shrī/ zhes sogs dang*/ gaṃ gau rī oṃ shrī badz+ra= zhes sogs nas/ ḍaṃ ḍom+bhi nī oṃ shī badz+ra he ru ka= zhes sogs bzla/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du 'khod par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ chu bzhi nyer spyod gos zung nang mchod/ yid byung bstod pa rnams sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin byas la/ rang gi lce la bdud rtsi myangs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de nas sgrub grogs gcig / aṣ+ta= bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug /rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa sgrub khang gi phyi'am/

dkyil 'khor dang yol bas bar du chod pa'i sar phyin la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i stegs la gtor ma gcig dang*/ de'i g.yas su chu bzhi dang*/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga mdun nas rgyab tu sbreng tshar dang*/ mdun du nang mchod kyang bshams/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar a las byung ba'i = zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog gi bar sta gon gyi gtor chog bzhin byas la/ phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ deng nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar du bsrung ba dang*/ sdong grogs mdzod/ rdo rje'i glu blangs/ phun sum tshogs pa = sogs dang*/ rigs su skye dang = sogs kyi smon lam btab/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa a s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi ka lpān a pa na ya hūṃ/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ de'i tshe slob mas mchod yon gyi chus gtor snod la bskor te lhag ma gtor ma 'gro phyogs su sbrengs la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri ye/ ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ri bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥmuḥ zhes yi ge brgya pa bco lnga pa dang*/ aṣ+ta/ bzla zhing*/ gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pas sa gtsang sar skyal te/ rol mo rgyun chags dang bcas pas slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du log ste/ yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing*/ shong na dngos su dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bya/ mi shong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas byas par bsam la/

de nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad par gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de/ lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel byed na dngos gzhi nyi ma dang po la/ bum pa sgrub mi dgos phyi ma rnams la skabs 'dir bum skyed sngar ltar bya'o/ / bdun pa dbang gi cho ga la/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis = sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ las bum gyi chus kha bshal/ de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bdag med ma yis mgṛn 'khyud pa'i = zhes sogs/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /blo chen gyis ni bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pas/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ / 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/

/yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyed kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*/ /'dod la log par mi spyad cing*/ /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ / chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang spang mi bya/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyed kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*/ /phyag rgya gzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ / ces dam tshig bsgrags/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi = zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang = zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum byas la/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ lan gsum/ mig dar dang me tog bzung*/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing las bum gyi chu gtor/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga' zhes dang*/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/

oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pā da ya mi/ rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /hūṃ dzaḥhūṃ/ zhes nang du zhugs par mos/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yis khyod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ / zhes dang*/

'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ oṃ pañca a mṛ ta ud ta ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes nang mchod dam bum chu myang ba dang*/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba ste khyod kyi bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyas par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang gi rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu re re/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i lte ba la hūṃ/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la āḥ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su ha/ rkang pa'i 'og tu rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gi dzhai+eṃ mer 'bar te/ long bu'i rtsa nang nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa'o che'i nang na yar zhugs nas sum mdo'i me dang 'dres nas cher 'bar ba/ de'i stobs kyis snying kha'i sa bsros/ mgrin pa'i chu skol/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis gyen la bteg /spyi bo'i rlung gis thur la mnan/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byon te/ kha ba chen po bab pa bzhin du ba spu'i bu ga nas lus la sib sib thim par gyur/ hūṃ ā ha dzhaiṃ a be shā ya/ stāṃ bha ya/

staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ /tsā la ya tsā la ya/ hūṃ ā hā dzhe+e+eṃ/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab bo/ / zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun kyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ / ces bstod/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha gṛh+na stāṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur te/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ mig dar dbye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyed kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang la lhung gyur ba/ /de ni khyod kyi he ru ka / zhes brjod/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*/ /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la = sogs lan gsum brjod/

dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i skur gyur/ steng du bla bre g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' bskor kun du dung dang*/ rnga bo che dang*/ 'phan dang me tog gi 'phreng ba la sogs pa mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ ni ri= sogs nas/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ zhes chu bzhis sbyangs la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/ badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes til dang*/ oṃ hūṃ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces chus sbyangs/ bdag gi byur dang skal pa ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs brjod cing*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wā= sogs dang*/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ gnyis ka mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje dang*/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma/ khar 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma/ lte ba'am snying khar bdag med rdo rje ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ £© thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/

thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa/ kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be shā ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ £© slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyod kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi skyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs dang*/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ aṃ las rin po che ser po aṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/

gnyis ka rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i= nas/ mig sogs byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs nas gsol ba gdab pa sngar ltar bya ba las/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyom par zhugs= zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur= de nas sngar ltar dbang gi lha la gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi= nas/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra shā le ho/ yang chu dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa= sogs/ zhes gsung zhing = nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag / tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gong 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /swa bha wa= sogs dang*/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka mi dmigs te= dz+riṃ las pad+ma dmar po dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las= 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad= phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma= yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur= 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ sangs rgyas kun kyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ / sangs rgyas kun du rab sgrub phyir/

/rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyi long zha ེ sa dang*/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa= nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang*/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ phung po gnas gyur £© so sor rtog pa'i ye shes £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ mngon du byas £© 'od dpag med kyi £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ go 'phang mngon du gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / £© swa bhā wa= sogs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka= khaṃ las ral gri ljang khu khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ don yod grub pa = kyai rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal brgyad= g.yas brgyad ral gri= g.yon brgyad de yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu= dbang rdzas la dbang bskur= don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa dhi s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭhi badz+ra sa ma ya/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa= don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ de ltar na= dril bu'i= phrag dog= 'du byed kyi= bya ba grub pa'i ye shes= don yod grub pa'i= swa bhā wa/ sogs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te= a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa= bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po= phyag g.yas brgyad 'khor lo/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo= slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las/ 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ £© bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa= sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan/ de ltar na ming gi dbang = gti mug dang gzugs kyi £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ phung po gnas gyur/

£© chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ mngon du byas/ £© rnam par snang mdzad kyi £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can tu byas pa yin no/ / £© dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes lta bar bya/ /swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ £© a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po'i rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid £© rdo rje sems dpa' kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad/ zhes sogs phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa bzhin/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje dang*/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ £© yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo sogs/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'-i/ mig sogs byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ ye shes pa bzhugs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ snang ba ser sna rdo rje ma/ khar 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma/ lte ba'am snying gar bdag med rdo rje ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ £© thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dgug gzhug bya/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be shā ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ chu dbang ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer ba'i 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ £© oṃ badz+ri bha wa sogs kyi chu dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ de nas sngar ltar dbang gi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyod kyi 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ / £© 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ badz+ra dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi/ hi hi hi hūṃ/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul la/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang*/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*/ /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi=

nas/ hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyem ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bzung*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / ces dang*/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par gyur/ /rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bus 'khyud pa/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung cig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ / de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin du bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su grags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ sogs £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ £© oṃ badz+ri bha wa nas a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/

dbang gi lha thams cad rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭhi badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ / dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid/ /gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/ /sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs nyid/ /de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /gang zhig byams pa la sogs sems/ /thig skud bzhir ni brjod pa'o/ /rdo rje'i thig tu gang bshad pa/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa'o/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig tu brjod pa yin/ /rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa ni/ /tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa'o/ /dbang po lnga yi sems gang yin/ /rwa ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid/ /gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi po ni/ kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa nyid/ /sgo khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /de bzhin me tog 'phreng rgyan pa/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po yin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni rab tu grags/ /gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste/ /kun tu gcod pa'i ngo bo yin/ /nyon mongs 'phrog pa'i dra ba nyid/ /tshogs gnyis dag pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa/ / nyon mongs phyed ni gcod pas na/ /do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi ste/ sbyang bya dgu po rnam par dag cing*/ don dam ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi ste/ chos nyid rigs dgu'i ngo bo lha dgu nyid do/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ / zhes de nyid gsum brjod pa'o/ / deng nas brtsam ste rdzogs sangs rgyas/

/sras dang bcas la rnam rol zha ི nga*/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ a/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yi bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ / myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ gi de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ / gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyi/ hoḥ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ / brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyi ni tshim par gyis/ /hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ / byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ bh+ruṃ/ chos kyi me ni legs spar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig mdongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron me spar bar gyis/ pra rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ gha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig thur dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ / sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ / zhes me long dang*/ a/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/

/nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ / zhes dril bu dang*/ hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig / ces mda' gzhu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig / ces me long gnyis pa bstan/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga rwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe āḥ a/ deng nas rtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ / dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod/ / ces 'khor lo dung dril bu po ti bzung ste chos bshad dang*/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ / sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po gsum 'dra ba byas la/ rdo rje 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de ltar na khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo bskor/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor cig / ces sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsrung*/

lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes brjod gsang dbang zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ khyed kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje £© yid kyis dgyes/ zhes bstod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mig dar bcing*/ yab yum thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi khar babs pa'i byang chub sems kyi thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /a ho mahā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis mig dar bsal/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /sa bla sa 'og sa steng rnams su bhur bhu wa swa/ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung bstan par mdzad de/

sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di yi mthu yin no/ / zhes brjod de lung bstan pa'o/ / de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te mthong*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag /dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa dang*/ lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes brjod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs= sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan zhi ba sogs gong bzhin gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ*/ mig dar bcing bla mas bdag la rig ma gtad de/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ / bzung shig bzung shig sems dpa' che/ /bzung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ / zhes gsungs par bsam/ des kyang 'di skad ces/ bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ / zhes dris pa la/ bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to/ / zhes lan btab/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ / de'i mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+mar ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ / blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pas lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog gi dga' bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong g.yogs phye/

'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyi nam yang mi bya'o/ /mahā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dam tshig bshad/ rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung*/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang spang bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni/ dka' thub kyis kyi mi gdung zhing*/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar bzung*/ /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes pas dbugs dbyung ba bya/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ / zhes dang*/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun kyi mthun par gsungs/ / sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyis cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan btags drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung ba mdzod/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ / zhes dbugs dbyung bya/ shin tu spros pa la dga' na/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad pa nyid mi bya/ /sems can rnams la sdug byams dang*/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/

/skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la des mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing*/ /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni bzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ / dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung bar bya/ /gtsug gtor rtag tu bzung bar bya/ / rtag tu sbyin sreg bkang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor gzhed bar bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sby-in/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spangs shing*/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing*/ /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*/ /rtag pa ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzaṃ bha la la chu sbyin zhing*/ /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang*/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /
