zhes brjod/ 'di dag dbugs dbyung du bzhed kyang gcig tu de ltar ma nges la/ dbang gsum pa kho na dang 'brel ba'ang min mod/ dbang spyi'i dam tshig yin pa'i phyir skabs 'dir brjod na legs par yang 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje gur las 'di dag spyir dam tshig du bshad pa yin gyi/ cho ga'i skabs su gsungs pa min pas mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'ang min no/ / de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa dang*/ lam pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes brjod/ de nas dbang bzhi pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul la/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*/ /rnam pa kun kyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyi rlobs/ / lan gsum brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong bcing*/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ / zhes brjod cing don bsam/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi 'chi ba/ /zhes kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ / zhes brjod de/ gzengs bstod pa'o/ / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa dang*/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/

/ zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ deng nas rtsams te dag bran du/ nas/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /kye rdo rje bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun kyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ / 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun kyi mchog /gdon nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag sgrub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun kyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun kyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun kyi yid la zhugs/ /sems can kun kyi yab gyur zhing*/ /'dod chags snyems pa'i dam tshig mchog / zhes lan gcig dang*/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun kyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / de'i rjes su gtor ma rnams gong ltar 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag 'jug nyid 'don pa spos pas 'grub ste 'on kyang lag len ni mthong ba brgyud pa las shes par bya'o/

/ rgyad pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ phyi nang yid byung bstod thung rnams bya/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ / sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel yin na dngos gzhi nyi ma snga ma rnams la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ ras bris dang*/ nyi ma phyi ma la yang rten gzhan la brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin na/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ a kā ro= sngags bzla bzhin du/ rdo rje'i rtse mos dbang ldan nas brtsams/ rtsig pa thog mar sub/ lha mtshan rnams dang por bsdus/ lhag ma rnams phyags te snod du blugs la/ chu bor spyan 'dren tshul ni spyi dang 'dra/ nang du 'ong nas thig rnams bkru zhing*/ sngar phur bu dngos su btab yod na phyung*/ smon lam ci 'grub gdab/ kun rdzob chos rnams kun kyi stong pa'i gzhi/ /don dam chos nyid bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ /snying rje stong nyid he dang badz+ra dag /gnyis su med des bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro la chags pa'i spyan/ / ye shes mig gcig mig bral mig gi mchog /ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa kun nas spyan/ /bkra shis spyan des gzigs shing dge legs stsol/ /phrag dog med pa'i phrag dog thams cad pa/ /byams pa'i thugs mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i slad/ /yan lag med pa'i rdo rje yan lag nag /bkra shis sku de ston pas dge legs stsol/ /gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub sbyin pa dang*/ /snyan smra don spyod don dang mthun pa'i zhabs/ /cha med kun 'gro kun la bkra shis pa/ /kun nas zhabs des bgrod cing dge legs stsol/ /rang bzhin 'gyur med rnam pa brgyad kyi zhal/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang zhal med zhal bzang po/ /sgra med chos sgra mkha' khyab sgrogs pa'i zhal/

/bkra shis sgo de 'byed cing dge legs stsol/ /phung po khams dang dbang po rnams dang ni/ /mar ngo'i tshes rnams kun kyi stong pa'i gzhi/ /don dam gzhan stong bcu drug bkra shis can/ /kun nas phyag des skyong zhing dge legs stsol/ /yar ngo'i tshes dang 'dzag bcas dga' ba rnams/ /gdod nas ngo bo nyid kyi 'gags pa'i gzhi/ /'gyur med dga' ba de nyid bcu drug gis/ /bde stong bkra shis gnas 'dir sbyin gyur cig /yi ge med cing brjod du med pa'i dbyings*/ /stong pa chen po yi ge lnga yi bdag/ sangs rgyas mnga' bdag bkra shis cod pan ni/ /rtag par thod du 'ching bas dge legs stsol/ /phyi nang glo bur dri ma gdug pa can/ /'dul bar mdzad phyir bde gshegs snying po mchog khro bo'i skur ston bdud 'dul bkra shis kyi/ khyed la gegs med bkra shis mdzad gyur cig /bde gshegs snying po dgyes pa rdo rje sha /sha med sha bzang don dam sha gang yin/ /'phags ma puk+ka sī'i bkra shis kyis/ /gnas 'dir rtag tu shis par mdzad gyur cig /don dam gzhan stong dgyes pa rdo rje khrag /rdul med rdul bral chos sku'i khrag gang yin/ /'phags ma shā bā rī'i bkra shis kyis/ /gnas 'dir bkra shis nyi ma 'char gyur cig /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde stong ye shes kyi/ khu ba gang lags gdol pa mor gsungs pa/ /dpe med don dam khu ba'i bkra shis kyis/ /gnas 'dir bkra shis zla ba 'char gyur cig /'dus ma byas dbyings bde gshegs snying po yi/ / rkang dang tshil bu pra phab brgyad mtshungs gang*/ /'phags ma g.yung mo'i bkra shis rgya mtsho yis/ /gnas 'dir bkra shis rgya mtsho bskyel gyur cig /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i bdag /dgyes pa rdo rje'i pags pa rnam dag gang*/ /byang chub yan lag bdun gyis bkra shis kyis/ /gnas 'dir bkra shis yan lag 'phel gyur cig /rten 'brel las 'das gzhom du med pa'i

dbyings/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i rus mchog chos nyid kyi/ /bden pa bzhi po'i bkra shis ri bo yis/ /gnas 'dir bkra shis ri dbang spel gyur cig /zla nyi gdod nas 'gags pa'i zla nyi gzhan/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od dang ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma snang chen byin rlabs kyis/ /shis brjod mchog 'di yang dag 'grub gyur cig /snying kha'i rtsa brgyad lte bar bcas pa la/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa'i dgyes rdor lha dgu yi/ /byin rlabs mthu stobs mkha' khyab bden pa'i mthus/ /shis brjod 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ // ces pa dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis las rim grub chen bi ru pa'i man ngag du grags pa'i ngag 'don mdo tsam brjod pa ste/ rgyas par slob dbon rtse mos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang*/ bla ma 'phags pa'i bdag 'jug rgyas bsdus rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /spyir dkyil chog gi lugs 'di/ rin chen 'bar ba dang nag po gzhung 'grel gnyis na/ phan tshun du bsdus pa lta bur yod cing*/ yan lag phra mo mang po de gnyis las mi 'byung bar/ man ngag kho na'i dbang du byas pa'ang snang la/ rgyab brten du gzhung de nyid la sbyangs na/ nges pa rnyed pa la gnad che'o/ /zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā na ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po jo nang gi 'dabs/ dpal rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang du lo gsar pa'i tshes la'o/ /yi ge pa ni kun dga' legs pas bris/ dge bas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par shog /dge legs 'phel/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bi rū pa'i man ngag gong ma'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 136 -- PAGE 137 -- PAGE 83 -
